prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity mobile UX review board for Palla organizer session creation, with THREE equally sized tall portrait app screens side by side, fully visible and readable. No physical device frames, browser, photographs, charts or decorative illustrations. Small board labels outside screens: '1 — Your sessions', '2 — Place & schedule', '3 — Players & price'. Input reference contributes ONLY the established Palla brand, typography and native chrome; do not copy its content or unread badges. Fixed light-only palette: pale lavender #fbf8ff background, white #ffffff fields/cards, ink #1a1b22, olive #536600, lime #d4ff00 primary actions, pale selected lime #f7ffd5, subtle borders #e3e1ec. Hanken Grotesk headings/body, generous 24-unit margins, thin outlined icons, medium 12-unit rounded fields, 48-unit touch targets, quiet professional native task UI. All text English, legible at actual phone scale, no oversized marketing headline. Illustrative Buenos Aires sessions only.
Screen1: iOS status bar, Palla header and notification bell with NO badge. Heading 'Sessions', subtitle 'Manage the games you host.' Full width lime '+ Create session'. Segmented filter 'Upcoming' selected / 'Drafts' / 'Past'. Date heading 'Tuesday, October 20'. One tidy white session card: 'Tuesday social padel', Published status, '19:00–20:30', 'Palermo Padel · Court 2', '7ma–6ta · 6 / 8 players', small 'Repeats weekly' and chevron. Second date 'Saturday, October 24', card 'Weekend games', '10:00–11:30', 'Belgrano Padel', 'All categories · 4 / 8 players'. Bottom native tabs Overview grid icon / Sessions calendar icon selected pale lime tile / Profile person icon. No other dashboard clutter.
Screen2: full-screen create stack with native statusbar, Back left, 'Create session' header, Close right; NO bottom tabs. Step indicator '1 of 3 · Place & schedule'. Heading 'Where and when?' Form fields: Session name value 'Tuesday social padel'; Club search field value 'Palermo Padel' with search icon; quiet 'Can’t find your club? Add a location' link; Court optional value 'Court 2'. Divider. Date 'Tue, Oct 20, 2026' calendar field; side by side Start '19:00' End '20:30'. 'Repeat' segmented 'Once' / 'Weekly' selected. 'Every Tuesday · Buenos Aires time' helper; 'Last session' value 'Nov 17, 2026'. Fixed bottom area secondary 'Save draft' text and full lime 'Continue' button, safe area respected. Fields fit through scrolling with visible continuation, never microscopic type. 
Screen3: same create stack no tabs. '2 of 3 · Players & price'. Heading 'Who can join?' 'Categories' choice All categories / Choose range selected. Side by side 'From' '7ma' / 'To' '6ta' dropdown fields. Helper 'Lower numbers mean stronger play.' 'Player capacity' number field value '8' with minus/plus controls. 'Price per player' field 'ARS 12,000', helper 'Players pay outside Palla.' 'Registration closes' field '2 hours before'; 'Players can cancel until' field '24 hours before'. Optional 'Notes for players' text area 'Bring your racket. Balls included.' Bottom secondary Save draft and lime 'Review session'. Keep coherent restrained hierarchy; all app content is working controls and session facts. Board footnote 'Design proposal · Illustrative data'.
approval: User approved implementation October 13, 2026, with visual refinement deferred.
